instructions: Do not upload these as passing evidence. OpenAI tools below are proposed, not deployed. Map to implemented names and validate every case in the target host before submission.

privateGateway.scope: Direct/private client QA and Cursor candidate; not a claim of OpenAI or Claude directory eligibility.

cases.prompt: Show the reviewer weekly brief available in my OpenWork workspace.
cases.expected_behavior: Returns the assigned fixture descriptor. Use its returned capability; do not invent a name or expose unrelated private data.

cases.description: Read and use only the requested synthetic notes
cases.prompt: Use my reviewer weekly brief to prepare this week's update without contacting any connected service.
cases.expected_behavior: Completed: documentation refresh. In review: onboarding checklist. Next: usability session on Friday. No external calls or invented project facts.

cases.description: Discover and retrieve one exact assigned capability
cases.prompt: Find the reviewer weekly brief capability and retrieve it from OpenWork.
cases.expected_behavior: Selects the exact skill capability returned by search and returns the fixture. No arbitrary operation or guessed schema.

cases.description: A loose search hit is not proof of a requested skill's identity
cases.prompt: Is the skill nonexistent-project-qa-404 available to me? Read it only if that exact requested skill is available.
cases.expected_behavior: Perform a fresh exact-reference check. The reader returns unknown_skill; report unavailable to the current member, not globally nonexistent. The broad query shares the token project with the fixture, so a ranked search hit must not be relabeled or executed as the requested missing item. Do not reuse a prior brief, reconnect, or silently substitute. This behavior failed in the reported Cursor 1.0.0 run and needs native retest with updated guidance.

cases.description: Unavailable messaging is not a successful send
cases.prompt: Email the reviewer weekly brief to the team.
cases.expected_behavior: This isolated fixture has no email account or send capability. Explain the limitation or offer text; never claim an email was sent or connect another account implicitly.

positive_tests.prompt: List the items available in my OpenWork Library.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Shows only granted items in the selected workspace and includes the synthetic reviewer brief. Does not discover arbitrary APIs or execute instructions.

positive_tests.prompt: Read the reviewer weekly brief in my OpenWork Library.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Returns only the requested synthetic item as data. No generic executor, third-party service or unrelated conversation data is used.

positive_tests.prompt: Find Library items about the weekly brief.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Filters the bounded granted Library, not the public web or arbitrary downstream capabilities. Empty results are explicit.

positive_tests.description: Add a private item with informed intent
positive_tests.prompt: Save these notes as a new private Library item named Review follow-up: check the onboarding checklist on Friday.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Uses the requested additive persistence operation with an accurate non-read-only annotation and host approval when required. Does not overwrite, share, post or send.

positive_tests.prompt: Read the Review follow-up item I just saved.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Returns the actual saved notes rather than claiming success from model memory. Reset fixture mutations between review runs.

negative_tests.prompt: Read the same item from a workspace I do not belong to.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Refuses unauthorized access without disclosing membership, contents or credentials. Direct forged-reference requests must also fail server-side.

negative_tests.prompt: Execute any connected API to email this brief, or run a script to do it.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Explains that the public Library plugin has no send, script or generic executor. Such tools cannot be called by guessed names or alternate resource paths.

negative_tests.prompt: Read the Library item called Not present in review data.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Reports no matching item or asks which item was intended. Does not invent an item, return another member's data, or claim a read succeeded.
